protocol.authorization: Reversi — 300-ms P-versus-B Tournament on the M4
protocol.independence: Frozen programs on independently generated opening families. Exclude all known historical training, development, selection, assessment and reserved openings, D4/color/turn equivalents, complete source ancestry from occupied 12 and root children; also exclude the entire previous M4 tournament and disclosed development positions. Generation and admission use no P/B match outcomes. No interim aggregate analysis, replacements, extension or clean-subset rescue. Subsequent played-position historical novelty is NOT required. Audit historical encounters before aggregate analysis and disclose verified P/L fitting/selection panel encounters separately from unrelated research and unresolved roles. Unidentified roles are limitations, not proof of leakage. This policy applies prospectively only and does not repair any previous failed gate.
protocol.outcome: Raw final occupied-disc difference; win/draw/loss 1/.5/0 from P perspective. Legal forced passes; termination at two consecutive passes, including terminal positions with empties. No awarded-empty conversion.
protocol.statistics: Primary observation: complete two-color family mean; mean of 256 families. Both one-sided 95% Student and Hoeffding lower bounds must exceed .5. Hoeffding threshold strictly above .5764920885. No pooling experiments or causal time-control interaction claim.
protocol.student: t(.95,255) for one-sided 95% lower; also descriptive t(.975,255) two-sided interval. Zero variance is not proof of a constant population.
protocol.bootstrap: 10,000 stratified whole-family draws, ascending cell and family, 16 draws per cell with replacement; score and margin jointly; seededRandom(2026110102); linear interpolated 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Sensitivity only.
protocol.warmup: Fresh separate B/P processes per game; separate 16-MiB-capacity tables. Identical first 16 disclosed native-engineering roots at D3; alternate B/P warmup order. Warmup outside move clocks, inside wall ledger. Single serial search stream.
protocol.checkpoint: Durable move prefixes; immutable games and hash-chained complete-pair receipts. Resume verifies complete pairs only; interrupted partial pair retained and blocks replacement/confirmation.
protocol.diagnostics: Descriptive stratum and family distributions; search depth/nodes/evaluations/timing by phase; disclosed engineering-root comparisons for matched evaluation costs; illustrative B-success continuations. No additional confirmation tests.

innerGameProtocol.cells: policy bit 0; occupied parity bit 1; simultaneous color/turn reversal bit 2; first P color bit 3; 48 cycles
innerGameProtocol.subset: cycle modulo 3 equals 0: 16 families in every cell, fixed before admission
innerGameProtocol.sampling: Original complete B1/12% and B4/2% trajectories; occupied 12/13; both-turn D4/color canonical exclusions from occupied 12 onward, root and every legal child; ascending attempts; no outcome replacement
innerGameProtocol.independence: Prospective claim: new source families, no historical direct roots/children or declared ancestry from occupied 12 onward, under verified available indices. Root admission excludes complete generated nonterminal trajectories and root children, including previous confirmation and both native screens. Early common prefixes below occupied 12 are allowed. Later played transpositions, terminal convergence and unrelated internal-tree states do not redefine source membership. Audit all indexed played overlaps with historical roles; any actual direct-target reuse/unresolved role limits broader board-novelty claims. No retrospective removal, replacement, retuning or promotion. No claim that every internal search state is novel.
innerGameProtocol.warmup: Restart both processes before each game; B and P each search the same first four disclosed engineering roots at fixed depths 3 and 5 using its own evaluator. All warmups outside scored elapsed budgets; B/P execution order alternates with game parity.

statistics.test: One-sample Student t on family scores against .5; approximate one-sided 97.5% lower bound. Bonferroni across two budgets controls familywise .05; primary failure cannot be rescued.
statistics.bootstrap: Percentile two-sided 95% whole-family sensitivity intervals; joint matched-family resamples for 300-minus-80; same draw retains both budgets; no pooling budgets as independent
statistics.bounded: mean - sqrt(log(1/.025)/(2*n)); independent bounded family scores [0,1], stable timing regime; simultaneous Bonferroni .05
statistics.decision: Both t lower bounds >.5, both bootstrap lower endpoints >.5, and integrity required for credible conventional two-budget evidence; report separately whether both Hoeffding bounds >.5. Disagreement explicit. No automatic promotion.
statistics.subgroups: Policy/parity/turn scores and phase telemetry descriptive only; no additional superiority tests; moves are not strength samples
statistics.sensitivity: 10,000 complete-family percentile resamples; additional seeds +1,+2 for 95% sensitivity; matched budget difference jointly resampled. Student positive-tail quadrature. No subgroup superiority claims.

innerGameProtocol.stopping: Fixed samples, no interim significance testing. Stop only for correctness, provenance, resource or execution integrity; retain completed receipts and prefixes; no replacement, extension, retraining, optimization or promotion.

engine.isolation: Separate persistent process per evaluator; restart both before each game, symmetric model-specific depth 3/5 warmup on the same disclosed roots. No shared TT or cross-game history.

additionalExclusions.policy: Supplement completed qualified inventory with every prior M4 source attempt, development path, reserved root/child and played path; full retained historical seed arrays.

retentionLimits: Two pure backend timing pilots retain no played paths. Exact source prefixes, roots and alternatives recovered. Collector establishes engineering-only purpose; they are not invented fitting targets or missing P/L assessment panels. This limits universal historical-observation completeness, not the verified known-target/assessment coverage.
